workflow: An execution object is created with an owned reference, while garbage-collector registration is deferred until after compilation succeeds.
Compilation or later optimized execution can fail through a recoverable exception path rather than the normal fatal or null-return path.
Cleanup releases the object only on the handled paths, leaving the owned reference unreleased on that exception path.
Repeated failures retain each abandoned object, causing memory usage to grow and leak detection to report unreclaimed allocations.
summary: Exceptional execution path omits ownership release and leaks generated objects
